subject: Two-factor sign-in is on
preheader: Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe.
footer_note: You're getting this because you have a VF Tech account. Account emails like this one can't be turned off.
body: Two-factor sign-in is now on for your VFTech account. After you sign in, we'll ask for the code from your authenticator app. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe: each one works once if you lose your phone.
If this wasn't you, reply to this email or use the Can't sign in? page straight away.
